notablePrerequisites: Heronblade Elite has a +1/+1 counter on it and has power 3 or greater.
easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Heronblade Elite using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.
